Monotone Interval from a Fit and Half-Widths

Source: R/gam_adaptive_pi.R
monotone_interval.Rd

Each bound (mu -/+ half_width) is made non-decreasing in newdata by isotonic regression, which keeps lower <= mu <= upper when mu is monotone. The lower bound is truncated at 0.

Usage

monotone_interval(newdata, mu, half_width)

Arguments

newdata

Numeric vector of source RTs.

mu

Monotone predictions at newdata.

half_width

Half-widths at newdata.

Value

A matrix with 3 columns: [predicted, lower, upper].
